questions.stem: A 31y P1L1 visit on her 7th postnatal day following a vaginal delivery. She had gestational diabetes but otherwise her delivery was uncomplicated. She complains of bilateral nipple soreness when breastfeeding which has worsened. She is afebrile. Both the nipples have open, bloody linear abrasions. The breasts are diffusely engorged and mildly tender on palpation. There are no palpable masses. What is the most possible etiology of her problem?

options.label: B
options.text: Candida infection from the infant’s oral cavity

options.label: C
options.text: Hyperglycemia leading to mastitis and engorgement

options.label: D
options.text: Poor and incorrect latching by the infant
